    var now = Date.now();

    var wait;

      <div class="bk-faq">
                <details class="bk-faq__item">
          <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">Is the evaluation fee a one-time payment?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
          <p class="bk-faq__a">Yes. There are no subscriptions, recurring charges, or hidden fees. You pay once for the evaluation. If you pass, your account upgrades to funded status at no additional cost.</p>
        </details>
                <details class="bk-faq__item">
          <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">What happens if I fail the evaluation?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
          <p class="bk-faq__a">Your account closes and there are no additional charges or liability. To try again, purchase a new evaluation. Each evaluation is a fresh start.</p>
        </details>
                <details class="bk-faq__item">
          <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">What is the difference between 80/20 and 90/10 profit split?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
          <p class="bk-faq__a">80/20 is the standard split on all accounts. For an additional fee at checkout, you can upgrade to 90/10, meaning you keep 90% of every profit instead of 80%. The upgrade is permanent for that account.</p>
        </details>
                <details class="bk-faq__item">
          <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">Why is $200K only available on Pro and Turbo?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
          <p class="bk-faq__a">Pro and Turbo have tighter drawdown parameters (5% and 3% respectively) that scale appropriately at larger account sizes. The Classic plan has wider drawdown room which is capped at $100K.</p>
        </details>
                <details class="bk-faq__item">
          <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">How quickly can I get funded?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
          <p class="bk-faq__a">There are no time limits and no minimum trading days. You can theoretically pass in a single trading session if you hit the profit target.</p>
        </details>
                <details class="bk-faq__item">
          <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">How do payouts work once funded?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
          <p class="bk-faq__a">On-demand, 24/7. Request a payout any time with a $50 minimum (after profit split). Payouts are processed in USDC on Ethereum (ERC-20). No approval wait required to continue trading.</p>
        </details>
                <details class="bk-faq__item">
          <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">What is static drawdown?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
          <p class="bk-faq__a">Your maximum drawdown limit is set once when the account is created and never changes, regardless of how much profit you make. This is more forgiving than trailing drawdown, which follows your equity high.</p>
        </details>
                <details class="bk-faq__item">
          <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">Can I have multiple accounts?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
          <p class="bk-faq__a">Yes. You can hold up to $200K in total funded capital across all accounts combined. You can run multiple evaluations simultaneously.</p>
        </details>

            <p>Breakout’s evaluation program is intentionally rigorous and designed to verify a trader’s risk-management skill and strategy discipline before any proprietary capital is allocated.             <p>POL may receive financial incentives from third parties based on trade ideas provided by FTs. Any such revenue is retained solely by POL and is not shared with FTs. Breakout Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2026 Promotion Terms

These terms apply to the Breakout Black Friday and Cyber Monday 2026 promotion (the "Promotion"), which has two offers: an evaluation discount ("Offer A") and reduced trading fees ("Offer B"). They supplement the Breakout Terms. Evaluation fees are non-refundable for each attempt once trading begins, regardless of outcome.

2. Eligible Areas. Void where prohibited.

- Offer A: from [TBC: 27 November 2026, HH:MM UTC] to [TBC: 30 November 2026, HH:MM UTC].
- Offer B: 14 days from [TBC: 27 November 2026, HH:MM UTC], ending [TBC: end date and time, UTC] (the "Fee Offer Period").

<section class="bk-section bk-section--snow aff-faq" id="faq" data-screen-label="07 FAQ">
  <div class="bk-in">
    <div class="bk-titlebox">
      <h2 class="bk-h2">The <span>practical</span> stuff.</h2>
    </div>
    <div class="bk-faq">
            <details class="bk-faq__item">
        <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">How much do I earn per referral?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="bk-faq__a">12% of the first order placed with your code, rising to 15% at 40 referred traders and 18% at 150. Commission is paid on first orders only, and is calculated on the order value before the 5% client discount is applied.</p>
              </details>
            <details class="bk-faq__item">
        <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">When and how do I get paid?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="bk-faq__a">Commissions are paid in crypto. Each commission becomes available 5 days after the purchase, and you can request a payout once you reach the $100 minimum. You will need to complete identity verification (KYC, or KYB if you are applying as a company) before your first payout is released.</p>
              </details>
            <details class="bk-faq__item">
        <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">How does attribution work?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="bk-faq__a">Every approved affiliate gets a unique discount code. When someone uses it on their first purchase, that client is tied to you and the commission is yours. Affiliate links and cookie-based tracking are not part of this first release.</p>
              </details>
            <details class="bk-faq__item">
        <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">Who can join?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="bk-faq__a">Traders, creators, educators and community members with an engaged audience. You will need a registered Breakout account, and the email address on your application has to match the one on that account, so create it first if you have not already. Every application is reviewed before approval, and we do not accept everyone.</p>
              </details>
            <details class="bk-faq__item">
        <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">What am I not allowed to do?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="bk-faq__a">Do not bid on Breakout or Kraken brand terms in paid search, and do not present your content as official or imply you speak for us. Do not make income claims, promise profits, or post payout screenshots that are not your own. Do not use your own code on your own purchases.</p>
              </details>
            <details class="bk-faq__item">
        <summary class="bk-faq__sum"><h3 class="bk-faq__q">What do I get to work with?</h3><span class="bk-faq__chev" aria-hidden="true"></span></summary>
        <p class="bk-faq__a">A dashboard showing your referrals, tier progress and pending commission, plus a library of promotional materials. This is a self-serve program, so there is no dedicated account manager, and the terms are the same for everyone.</p>
              </details>
          </div>

<section id="disclosures" class="bk-disclosures">
  <div class="bk-disclosures__in">
    <h2>Important Disclosures about Breakout, Payward Oceanic Ltd. (“POL”) and the Funded-Trader Program</h2>
        <p>Breakout’s evaluation program is intentionally rigorous and designed to verify a trader’s risk-management skill and strategy discipline before any proprietary capital is allocated. Most applicants do not pass on their first attempt and there is no guarantee that your performance will improve or that you will pass any future evaluations. Prospective traders should purchase an evaluation only if they are confident in their trading ability and accept the risk of not qualifying for a funded account. Evaluation fees are non-refundable for each attempt once trading begins, regardless of outcome.</p>
        <p>If you pass the evaluation phase and become a funded trader (“FT”) with POL, all market-facing transactions, if any, are carried out exclusively by POL, for POL’s own principal account and at its sole discretion. FTs do not own any trading account or position, and hold no beneficial or proprietary interest in POL’s accounts, assets or trades. When an FT submits a trade idea, POL may, in its absolute discretion, either (i) record the idea as an internal, administrative book entry and calculate a hypothetical result without routing any order externally, or (ii) accept the idea for POL’s proprietary book and route the transaction to a market maker or exchange. FTs have no control over, or visibility into, the method POL selects.</p>
        <p>POL may receive financial incentives from third parties based on trade ideas provided by FTs. Any such revenue is retained solely by POL and is not shared with FTs. Because such financial incentives are not included in PnL for FTs, conflicts of interest may exist between POL and each FT. FTs should carefully consider these conflicts before participating. In addition, because Breakout earns fees each time an evaluation trader fails and then re-purchases an evaluation, conflicts of interest may also exist between Breakout and each evaluation trader.</p>
